summary: Today transforms into a prepared day from evening to morning, featuring a new editorial schedule, morning briefings, and a collapsible navigation rail.
intro: Today received its biggest evolution yet. Rather than just showing a list of disconnected cards, Today now guides your day from evening planning to morning briefing. A rich green hero banner welcomes you with Moss's daily assessment, weather, and schedule timeline, backed by an evening reflection flow and one-click morning briefing review. Desktop users also get a collapsible navigation rail for more focus.

headline.title: A prepared day, from evening to morning
body: Today is now a complete day-planning companion. Each evening, a guided four-step flow helps you reflect on the day, gauge your energy, choose tomorrow's focus, and draft a schedule. Overnight changes are tracked automatically.

In the morning, a dedicated briefing report presents Moss's assessment, summarizes your commitments, and lets you review proposed changes with a single 'Accept all' or adjust them block by block. The main Today page features a bold dark green hero band, an editorial timeline with distinct committed and proposed blocks, a quick-action rail, and dedicated desks for News and Sports.

items.title: Collapsible desktop navigation rail
items.body: A collapse button beside the Moss logo folds the desktop sidebar into a slim icon-only rail and remembers your preference across reloads, giving more breathing room to your daily workspace.

items.title: Evening planning flow
items.body: Plan tomorrow with a guided evening flow that steps through reflection, capacity, priority commitments, and schedule review before saving your plan draft.

items.title: Morning briefing reader and quick plan acceptance
items.body: Start your morning with a dedicated briefing report that highlights overnight changes and lets you accept proposed plan additions with one click or fine-tune them individually.

items.title: Revision-protected day plans
items.body: Moss now saves day plans in calendar storage with full revision tracking, allowing draft schedules to be prepared and reconciled without risking accidental overwrites.

items.title: Editorial timeline and Today hero band
items.body: The Today page opens with an assessment hero band showing prepared status, summary, and weather, leading into a numbered timeline distinguishing committed events from proposed blocks.

items.title: News and sports editorial desks on Today
items.body: News and sports on Today now read as curated editorial desks ('The wider world' and 'From the sidelines') with side-by-side desktop layouts and compact score recaps.

items.title: Grounded briefings with clear sources
items.body: Morning and evening briefings pull directly from your selected news and sports sources, providing verified context, compact scores, and clear provenance.

items.title: Design-fidelity typography
items.body: Moss now bundles self-hosted Archivo font weights for clean, authentic semibold headings and consistent theme palette tokens.

fixes.text: Moss automatically repairs older shared CLI installations during startup so multiple accounts share tools seamlessly.
Codex sign-in issues are clearly distinguished from network provider failures, with actionable administrator recovery steps.
Calendar plan updates reserve changes in durable batches before syncing, with automatic recovery if a connection is interrupted.
Briefing reports and schedule wrappers stack cleanly on mobile screens with full keyboard and screen reader accessibility parity.
